readiness.reason: Root registers direct frozen model versus complete current native system on unchanged exposed DEV1000; same model and resident geometry, full prepared features, exact request fitting and official complete scoring.

requirements.reason: Owner-directed direct versus complete native system admission

generation_budget.definition: Complete existing DEV1000; one direct response versus a live native episode. Bounds are ceilings, not forced calls.

population.decision_population: Historically exposed DEV1000; NEW500 primary, OLD500 and pooled secondary. Preserve variable-width candidates and all rows.

purpose: Matched pure frozen-model baseline: one direct-only task request per sample through the shared controller, FlightRuntime and OpenJiuwen executor. The full legal label/schema inventory is the task contract; no model-visible retrieved knowledge, candidate state, memory, review or analytical tool. Same prepared audio, model, sampling, per-request max256 and resident serving geometry as the complete current native system.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on failure; no automatic restart, replay, truncation, dose or geometry change. At most one separately registered recovery after a named root cause; second failure closes the flight.
